controles.affirmation: Litige M6 : "le groupe indique lui-meme qu'il n'est pas en mesure d'estimer l'effet financier de ces reclamations en cas de succes", verbatim "It is not possible to estimate the financial effect of these claims should they be successful."
controles.verbatim_source: URD FY2025 : la phrase citee ne porte PAS sur le M6. Elle cloture un paragraphe generique sur la responsabilite ordinaire de constructeur : "While the normal design liability applies in relation to completed design and construction projects in some entities within the Group, certain entities within the Group have the normal contractor's liability in relation to construction contracts. This liability may include litigation by or against the Group and / or joint arrangements in which the Group has an interest. It is not possible to estimate the financial effect of these claims should they be successful." La seule phrase d'incertitude propre au M6 est nettement plus faible : "Whilst not expected, it is possible that the final outcome could vary depending on the outcome of ongoing discussions between the parties."
controles.correction_proposee: Ne pas rattacher cette citation au M6. Ecrire : "le groupe indique, pour le M6, que meme si ce n'est pas attendu, l'issue finale pourrait varier selon le resultat des discussions en cours ; il precise par ailleurs, de facon generale, qu'il ne peut pas estimer l'effet financier des reclamations liees a sa responsabilite ordinaire de constructeur." C'est exactement le meme type de faute que "le DOJ enquete" pour "requests for information".

controles.affirmation: Le litige M6 est qualifie de "majeur" et de "non chiffrable"
controles.verbatim_source: URD FY2025 : aucune somme, aucune provision et aucun qualificatif de materialite ne sont associes au M6. Le document indique au contraire une desescalade : "On June 30, 2025, TfNSW and the M6 D&C JV reached agreement to complete surface works under a new deed and those works are now largely complete. By an agreement dated 8 October 2025, TfNSW and the M6 D&C JV agreed to continue without prejudice discussions regarding the impacted tunnelling works to find an appropriate commercial resolution ... Those without prejudice discussions continue." et "The M6 D&C JV will continue care and maintenance activities on the site until June 30, 2026."
controles.correction_proposee: Retirer "majeur" (rien ne l'etaye) et mentionner l'accord du 8 octobre 2025 sur des discussions commerciales sans prejudice, ainsi que l'achevement des travaux de surface. Le point valable est l'absence de chiffrage et le maintien du site en care and maintenance jusqu'au 30 juin 2026.

controles.affirmation: Le tunnel M6 Stage 1 a ete arrete en 2025 apres la decouverte de conditions geologiques imprevues ; la coentreprise a declare le contrat caduc, position contestee par le donneur d'ordre
controles.verbatim_source: URD FY2025 : "During the course of 2024, the project encountered differing and adverse ground conditions and geological issues not reasonably anticipated at time of tender. As a consequence, works in the affected areas were stopped. As a result of these geological issues, in May 2025 the M6 D&C JV determined the project cannot be completed as contemplated by the contract and, as such, the contract has been frustrated with the M6 D&C JV's obligations discharged by operation of law. This determination has been disputed by TfNSW. All tunnel construction activity has ceased."
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance de date : l'arret des zones affectees date de 2024 ; c'est la declaration de caducite qui date de mai 2025. Ecrire "arrete a partir de 2024, contrat declare caduc en mai 2025".

controles.affirmation: La sentence d'arbitrage sur le Royal Adelaide Hospital est encore attendue en 2026
controles.verbatim_source: URD FY2025 : "The arbitration hearing is complete with closing submissions delivered in July and August 2024. The arbitration award is expected in 2026."

controles.affirmation: "La cloture des investigations CIMIC/Leighton ouvertes depuis 2012 sans mise en cause d'une societe du groupe" (ce_qui_affaiblirait)
controles.verbatim_source: URD FY2025 : "On February 13, 2012, CIMIC announced that it had reported to the Australian Federal Police ("AFP") a possible breach by the Leighton International business of its Code of Ethics ... The AFP has also indicated it may charge a further ex-employee and that its investigations continue. CIMIC does not otherwise know when the charges will be heard or the outcome of any investigation. No CIMIC Group company has been charged. CIMIC continues to cooperate with all official investigations."
controles.correction_proposee: Renfort disponible non exploite : l'ASIC a clos son enquete des mars 2017 sans suite, alors que l'AFP poursuit la sienne et qu'un ex-salarie a plaide coupable (amende de 1 000 AUD). Ne jamais ecrire que CIMIC ou HOCHTIEF est mise en cause : "No CIMIC Group company has been charged".

controles.affirmation: Resultat net nominal S1 2026 : 467,6 M EUR (-2,8%) contre resultat net operationnel 479,7 M EUR (+35,2%)
controles.verbatim_source: Communique S1 2026 du 27/07/2026, HOCHTIEF Group Key Figures : "Operational net profit 354.8 479.7 35.2%" ; "Nominal net profit 481.0 467.6 -2.8%"
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance a integrer pour l'honnetete : sur le seul T2 2026 le resultat net nominal PROGRESSE de 48,7% (173,2 -> 257,6 M EUR). Le recul de -2,8% est un effet de base du S1 2025.

controles.affirmation: Droits de douane US 2026 sur equipements electriques, acier et aluminium chinois : "is expected to put pressure on MEP and facade systems" ; goulets electromecaniques europeens "similar to those in the U.S."
controles.verbatim_source: URD FY2025 : "The increase in tariffs on Chinese electrical equipment, manufactured steel, and aluminum planned for early 2026 is expected to put pressure on MEP and facade systems." et "Driven by the emerging market for data centers in Europe, we are experiencing bottlenecks in mechanical and electrical trades, similar to those in the U.S."
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance omise : le meme paragraphe precise que jusqu'ici l'impact est limite - "material prices and availability remained stable, with limited impact from tariffs so far" - et que le groupe integre le risque tarifaire dans ses prix en amont.
